title: Live verifier-routed search on the SCORED env (StepwiseExplorer + perception verifier, no separate arcade): budget-independence of the tu93 non-idempotent-reset block + g50t.
methodology_note: CarnotAgentPolicy(force_explore) searches the ONE env run_game gives it via RESET+replay (no separate offline arcade) -- the true live-search engine. Perception value_head = player->goal Manhattan (derived from a recon on the same game). tu93 gets budget 2000 to test whether its block is fundamental (non-idempotent reset -> no live fresh_env) or budget-limited. Public-game frames for offline dev.
context: Plan-then-replay (5839) searched a SEPARATE offline arcade twin (unavailable for a hidden game). This tests search ON the given env. Probe 2026-07-23: no clean idempotent-reset nav game in the public set (lp85/s5i5/vc33 derive no pair; only g50t=(9,8), win not pure nav); tu93 is the clean nav game but fresh_env/non-idempotent.
headline: HONEST BOUNDARY of live-search-on-the-scored-env: (1) live single-env search REACHES tu93 L1 (both the baseline explorer and the perception-routed arm) -- so limited live self-discovery on the scored env IS achievable; but (2) NEITHER reaches L2/L3 even at budget 2000 -- the offline solve's L3 relied on branch_mode='fresh_env' (a brand-new env per search node), which a single live scored env CANNOT supply because tu93's reset is non-idempotent (parity toggle); and (3) the perception verifier does NOT beat the baseline explorer here (both L1) -- its proven value (the OfflineSolver batch search, 5837/5838/5839) does NOT transfer to an advantage over the online StepwiseExplorer. g50t (the one idempotent game with a derived pair) is null both arms -- its win is not pure navigation.

boundary.offline_dev_twin_path: perception -> verifier -> OfflineSolver (fresh_env) reproduces tu93 L3, no hand-RE (5837/5838/5839). This is what arc_loop_solve/the dev twin uses; legitimate for the registry/dev.
boundary.true_live_scored_path: search on the ONE scored env. Reaches tu93 L1; DEEP solving (L2/L3) blocked by the non-idempotent reset (no live fresh_env). The perception verifier adds no advantage over the baseline explorer on the tested games.
boundary.why_the_gap: the offline solve's power comes from fresh_env branching (unlimited independent envs offline); the live scored setting has one env + a non-idempotent reset, so replay-from-reset search cannot reproduce a parity-contingent deep win.
boundary.public_set_limitation: no clean idempotent-reset navigation game exists in the public set to demonstrate a clean POSITIVE live-search-beats-baseline case (lp85/s5i5/vc33 derive no nav pair; only g50t=(9,8), not pure nav; tu93 is clean-nav but non-idempotent).

next_open_problem: Deep TRUE-LIVE solving of a non-idempotent-reset maze needs either (a) a parity-aware live search (model the reset's hidden-state toggle so replay-from-reset reproduces), or (b) a live search that branches without reset (a learned/deepcopy-able world model to roll forward candidates instead of resetting the real env). Both are genuine open research problems, not wiring gaps.
